pack_voltage.source: brief criterion 3 (six NiMH cells at 1.2 V); criterion 4 judges at it
pack_voltage.reason: the brief's nominal; every performance criterion is judged there

wheel_radius.source: brief criterion 2 (80 x 10 mm wheels, 0.040 m +- 0.001 m)

gear_ratio.source: parts sheet R2.08 (3344/65 from the tooth counts) and R2.04 (45:21); brief criterion 1 states 110.25 +- 0.5 %

external_stage_ratio.source: parts sheet R2.04; brief criterion 1 (the kit's 45:21 plastic stage)
external_stage_ratio.reason: exact from the tooth counts; its efficiency is taken as 1

motor_rated_voltage.reason: the voltage the sheet's figures are given at

motor_stall_torque.source: parts sheet R1.07 (0.74 kg*cm at 6 V, Pololu #3073)
motor_stall_torque.reason: extrapolated by the vendor; no tolerance is published; held at the value

motor_stall_current.source: parts sheet R1.03 (1.5 A at 6 V, Pololu #3073)
motor_stall_current.reason: extrapolated by the vendor; no tolerance is published; held at the value

motor_no_load_speed.source: parts sheet R1.10 (650 rpm at 6 V, typical, +- 20 %)

motor_no_load_current.source: parts sheet R1.05 (0.15 A at 6 V, typical, +- 50 %)

kit_mass.source: brief criterion 7 (Pololu #3575: motors, 80 mm wheels and bumper cage, no cells)

wheel_mass.source: parts sheet R9.03 (0.7 oz each, with tire, Pololu #1430)
wheel_mass.reason: given to one significant figure: half a unit either side

cell_mass.source: parts sheet R5.07 (0.97 oz each, Pololu #1003)
cell_mass.reason: given to two decimals: half a unit either side

com_height.reason: PROPOSED, for the owner: the body as a uniform box of the kit's 0.118 m height puts its centre 0.059 m above ground, 0.019 m above the axle; the cells (half the body's mass) sit along the axle plane (Pololu #3573). The range runs from just above the axle to the envelope's top (0.118 m above ground)
com_height.measure_by: the balance point of the assembled robot, with cells, on a knife edge at two orientations, or a CAD model with masses

body_inertia.reason: PROPOSED, for the owner: the body as a uniform box of the envelope, 0.118 m high and 0.080 m deep, about its centre of mass (0.3253 kg); half to one and a half times that
body_inertia.measure_by: a bifilar or compound-pendulum swing of the body about a known axis, or a CAD model with masses

wheel_inertia_factor.reason: PROPOSED, for the owner: the wheel as a uniform disc (1/2 m r^2), the documented default of the environment's first slice; a rim-heavy wheel lies towards a ring (m r^2)
wheel_inertia_factor.measure_by: a swing of one wheel about its axle, or the hub and tire masses separately

rotor_inertia.reason: PROPOSED, for the owner: no published figure for the gearmotor's rotor; 5e-8 kg*m^2 per motor is the illustrative value of the earlier fall check; half to double
rotor_inertia.measure_by: a spin-down of a bare motor from a known speed with its no-load current, or the vendor's figure if one is found

gearbox_friction.reason: PROPOSED, for the owner: the gearbox's breakaway torque at the wheel, read as all of the no-load current at the motor reflected through the ratio (0.1152 N*m/A x 0.15 A); the range carries the +- 50 % on that current and the choice of torque constant
gearbox_friction.measure_by: the torque needed to start one unpowered wheel turning against its motor, on a spring scale or a known weight
